reader: history_banks.OwnedKernels(catalog_path, require_complete=True); use with-context or close(). .times is exact grid; .sigma/.pi are greater/lesser/retarded read-only memmap dictionaries; .catalog retains full information contract. References to arrays must not outlive owner.
storage: Six independent complex128 NPY banks, sigma [time,time,128,12,12] and pi [time,time,114,114]. Each descriptor has absolute path, bytes, sha256, shape and dtype. catalog.json written only after successful complete declared work and flushed banks. Exception leaves no admissible catalog. Reuse/overwrite of an output directory is refused.
ownership: Each component declares owned pairs and, for EE/mixed_ei/cubic, owned q; records completed pairs/q separately. Complete requires all64 and all nt*nt pairs for all components, plus joint all pairs. Explicit partial=True is mandatory for strict subsets. Partial catalogs are consumer-ineligible by default and retain exact coverage; unowned storage zeros are not physical completion.
assembly: EE total + raw EI Sigma + joint Gamma Sigma - ionic Gamma Sigma; common Pi is full joint plus cubic only in first111 coordinates. No represented-only Pi stacked. Fresh cubic q-additive contraction is the same functional as the A56 paid-old-sum minus old0 plus dressed0 identity, since every prescribed nonGamma leg remains bare.
bounds: A60 exact inner64 EE owns static slots and pair tiles, reducing q contributions synchronously into final owned banks. EI, joint and cubic visit bounded pair tiles and call existing owning contractions. No per-q full-history output copies or whole-history evaluator operand bank. Saved NPZ NPY members are extracted byte-stream-wise into an owned temporary directory, mapped read-only, scanned pair-wise and removed on close.
allocation: Callable performs no subprocess launch or scheduling. Root alone authorizes production allocation. Nt31 is layout/code capability unless genuine nt31 output exists; the A62 smoke does not produce full31 physics.
